tax.text: Kaptur voted for the Inflation Reduction Act, which raised a minimum tax on large corporations and funded health, energy, and other programs.
tax.quote: By closing tax loopholes and establishing a minimum corporate tax applied only to the 150 largest corporations, the Inflation Reduction Act lowers healthcare and energy costs, expands American energy production, and reduces the federal deficit by $300 billion without raising taxes on small businesses or households making less than $400,000.

wages.text: She cosponsored the Raise the Wage Act of 2025, which would increase the federal minimum wage.
wages.quote: Marcy Kaptur (OH); Maxine Dexter (OR); Jared Huffman (CA)

trade.text: Her campaign says she supports tariffs to protect Ohio factories and companies.
trade.quote: She is fighting to bring jobs home, take away tax breaks from companies that ship jobs overseas, and for tariffs that protect Ohio-based factories and companies.

debt.text: Her campaign says she has fought to protect Social Security and Medicare from cuts and privatization.
debt.quote: She has fought to protect Social Security and Medicare from cuts and privatization, because working people have spent years paying into the system and they deserve to be covered.

housing.text: Her campaign says she supports increasing affordable housing supply, while noting that communities have different housing needs.
housing.quote: Marcy is a leader in efforts to increase the supply of affordable housing, while reducing the dangers of lead in legacy homes.

schools.text: Kaptur submitted a funding request for a Toledo Public Schools campus revitalization project.
schools.quote: Toledo Public Schools acquired the Scott Park Campus, launching an ambitious project to transform it into a hub for education, residential living, and recreation.

safety.text: Kaptur voted against a funding measure she said cut local law-enforcement funding and argued that police need more resources.
safety.quote: Less money for police means fewer officers on the streets and fewer resources to keep our communities safe.

immigration.text: Her platform combines expanded border security with legal immigration and comprehensive reform.
immigration.quote: Marcy believes in secure borders and legal immigration.

guns.text: Kaptur cosponsored the Bipartisan Background Checks Act of 2023.
guns.quote: To require a background check for every firearm sale.

cannabis.text: Kaptur voted for House passage of the MORE Act in 2020.
cannabis.quote: Vote Question: On Passage MORE Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay

health.text: Her official health-care page promotes the Affordable Care Act and public programs such as Medicaid to expand affordable coverage.
health.quote: The Affordable Care Act, which was signed into law on March 23, 2010, puts consumers in charge by ensuring access to quality, affordable health care.

energy.text: Her platform combines an all-of-the-above energy policy with renewable energy, lower costs, energy independence, and emissions reductions.
energy.quote: Marcy believes we need an “all of the above” energy policy.

voting.text: Kaptur cosponsored the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act of 2025.
voting.quote: To amend the Voting Rights Act of 1965 to revise the criteria for determining which States and political subdivisions are subject to section 4 of the Act, and for other purposes.

tax.text: Merrin says he led efforts to cut Ohio’s income tax and calls himself a strong advocate for lower taxes.
tax.quote: He is a strong advocate for lower taxes, simplifying the tax code, and promoting transparency.

housing.text: His campaign says he pushed through a law delaying property-tax increases on subdivided lots until development or sale.
housing.quote: After a five-year push, Merrin pushed through the Affordable Homebuilding & Housing Act, which blocks property tax increases on subdivided lots until the home is built or lot is sold.

schools.text: His campaign says he led efforts to expand school choice.
schools.quote: Derek successfully led efforts to cut the state's income tax, reduce regulations, and expand school choice.

safety.text: Merrin said he would stand by law enforcement and work to ensure police have the resources and manpower to protect residents.
safety.quote: I will stand by our law enforcement officers. I’m honored to have their support and look forward to continuing to work to ensure they have the resources and manpower necessary

immigration.text: Merrin said he would champion election integrity and secure the border, and supports requiring proof of citizenship to vote in federal elections.
immigration.quote: I will continue to champion the integrity of our elections and the need to secure our border to ensure the safety of Northwest Ohio families.

guns.text: Merrin cosponsored and voted for Ohio legislation allowing qualifying adults to carry concealed handguns without a license.
guns.quote: a right of a qualifying adult to carry a concealed handgun in the same manner as if the person was a licensee.

abortion.text: Merrin cosponsored Ohio’s bill prohibiting abortion after a detectable fetal heartbeat and voted for it in the House.
abortion.quote: to enact the Human Rights and Heartbeat Protection Act.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Merrin cosponsored Ohio’s SAFE Act and Save Women’s Sports Act, which restrict gender transition services for minors and require school sports teams to be designated by sex.
gender.quote: to enact the Save Women's Sports Act to require schools, state institutions of higher education, and private colleges to designate separate single-sex teams and sports for each sex.

voting.text: Merrin championed Ohio’s photo ID requirement law and said he would support proof-of-citizenship requirements for federal elections.
voting.quote: As one of the leaders of Ohio's photo ID requirement law, once elected to the U.S. House of Representatives, I will continue to champion the integrity of our elections

tax.text: His campaign platform calls for lowering and simplifying taxes for working families and small businesses.
tax.quote: Lower and simplify taxes for working families and small businesses

energy.text: His campaign platform opposes federal mandates that raise energy prices.
energy.quote: Oppose federal mandates that raise energy prices
